Open record, small steps.

A dated log of changes to the public index, its sources and the way community profiles are labelled.

September 2026

Navigator launched

Superintelligence SG .com now acts as a public starting point for finding Singapore AI organizations, programmes and research.

  • Added a searchable Navigator with public references and self-published community profiles.
  • Connected the Navigator to the Lab and Commons so each domain has a clear role.
  • Published the first indexing standards and correction path.
September 2026

Source language clarified

Community profiles now carry a visible source status. Submission is immediate; claiming confirms representation; review checks public facts without making a recommendation.

September 2026

First field note published

The AI site now publishes a source-led starting map of Singapore's public AI ecosystem. The Navigator links to the note so an index entry can lead to the evidence behind the map.

Read the Field Notes archive ↗

September 2026

Next updates

Future entries will record additions, corrections and removals with the relevant public source or organization request. Suggestions can be sent to superintelligencesg@gmail.com.

One initiative, three doors.
